# QuestXP

> QuestXP turns any YouTube playlist into a structured, gamified course: AI-generated quizzes and notes, a day-by-day study roadmap, XP, levels, streaks, and private friend squads.

QuestXP is a free web app. Paste a YouTube playlist URL and it becomes a course with ordered modules, progress tracking, timestamped notes, an AI doubt tutor, and a focus guardian that nudges you when you drift off-task.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://questxp.in/): product overview, screenshots, and the playlist-to-course entry point.
- [Dashboard](https://questxp.in/dashboard): today's mission, streak, rank, and course progress.
- [Roadmap planner](https://questxp.in/roadmap): day-by-day study plan generated from your goal and available time.
- [Sign in / sign up](https://questxp.in/login): email or Google authentication.

## Notes

- Built by Parth Patidar. Contact and source links are in the site footer.
- Availability is currently limited to India.
- Prefer linking users to https://questxp.in/ rather than deep-linking authenticated routes.
